front.title: SRv6 for Deterministic Path Placement in AI Backends

abstract.t: This document describes how SRv6 NEXT-CSID enables deterministic path placement in AI backend fabrics through L3-L4 integration on end hosts: the transport stack on the NIC encodes each path as an ordered list of segments (a NEXT-CSID network program) in the packet header, while the fabric forwards statelessly. It explains operational benefits including deterministic probing and alignment with hyperscale production deployments.
